name: Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack (14 Unique Maps)
author: HyruleChosenOne
description: Standalone custom levels pack adding all 7 Gen 3-9 regions (Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, Paldea) with 2 distinct playable maps each (14 levels total), featuring unique terrain profiles, weather, sanctuaries, and 3D centerpiece landmarks. Works standalone or paired with National Dex Gen 3-9.

customLevels.name: Petalburg Woods (Hoenn)
customLevels.desc: Mossy emerald woodland with sunken giant oaks, sunlit groves, and an ancient Moss Shrine centerpiece.

customLevels.name: Mt. Chimney Caldera (Hoenn)
customLevels.desc: Scorching volcanic rim crowned by steaming basalt vents, ash storms, and a smoking Magma Caldera landmark.

customLevels.name: Mt. Coronet Spear Pillar (Sinnoh)
customLevels.desc: Snow-swept summit rising above the clouds around the ruined marble columns of Spear Pillar.

customLevels.name: Eterna Twilight Woods (Sinnoh)
customLevels.desc: Misty dusk-lit forest and ancient marsh surrounding the haunted stone facade of the Old Chateau.

customLevels.name: Relic Desert Resort (Unova)
customLevels.desc: Golden shifting sands punctuated by sandstone hoodoos, sunken obelisks, and the stepped Relic Castle Pyramid.

customLevels.name: Dragonspiral Tower (Unova)
customLevels.desc: Autumn-gold highland cliffside anchored by the ancient multi-tiered Dragonspiral Pagoda Tower.

customLevels.name: Azure Bay Coast (Kalos)
customLevels.desc: Sunlit turquoise shoreline with tide pools, coral shoals, and a towering Twin Sea Arch & Beacon landmark.

customLevels.name: Reflection Crystal Cave (Kalos)
customLevels.desc: Prismatic subterranean grotto lit by giant mirror crystal clusters and glowing Aura fissures.

customLevels.name: Melemele Tropical Shore (Alola)
customLevels.desc: Sun-drenched island savanna and hibiscus meadows centered on the golden Ruins of Conflict Totem.

customLevels.name: Wela Volcano Park (Alola)
customLevels.desc: Obsidian volcanic slopes and glowing ember plains crowned by the ritual Wela Fire Altar.

customLevels.name: Galar Wild Area (Galar)
customLevels.desc: Windswept emerald moorland punctuated by weathered stone ruins and a glowing magenta Dynamax Raid Den.

customLevels.name: Crown Tundra Glacier (Galar)
customLevels.desc: Frozen sapphire plains beneath frosted pines and the ancient Crowned Temple Ice Monolith.

customLevels.name: Asado Titan Mesa (Paldea)
customLevels.desc: Sunbaked red-terracotta canyon highlands carved with wind arches and the towering Titan Mesa Arch.

customLevels.name: Area Zero Great Crater (Paldea)
customLevels.desc: Luminous abyss of swirling mist and floating crystals surrounding the iridescent Terastal Spire.
